name: new_v2_roam_static_posture_cross_user_v1
bout_aggregation: mean and standard deviation of all disjoint pure-label 200 ms windows after excluding 200 ms at both ends of each contiguous label bout
source_state: All feature state and classifier fit only source subjects 1-18 in resting posture; F0v2 thresholds fit only their label-0 windows. Validation/final signals never fit feature state or classifier.
classifier: StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260929, trained on source bouts
selection: maximize pooled validation macro-F1 across all four postures; break ties by lower validation log loss; final subjects never select arms
scope: Public Myo 8-channel 200 Hz, three-class static-posture cross-user transfer. Resting source posture and four target postures include the same validation/final users, so within-user posture strata are paired, while user and posture shift coexist relative to source. Bout-level scores are not online transitions and do not validate the user's 250 Hz device.
